records.key: (str) tracked_object — which mask the tracks come from.
records.source: (str) tracked_object — which mask the tracks come from.
records.translation: (str) tracked_object — de qual máscara vêm as trajetórias.

records.key: A NaN here is usually meaningful: a pathogen feature is NaN for a cell with no pathogen. Dropping the feature keeps every object; dropping the rows keeps every feature but changes which population you are looking at.
records.source: A NaN here is usually meaningful: a pathogen feature is NaN for a cell with no pathogen. Dropping the feature keeps every object; dropping the rows keeps every feature but changes which population you are looking at.
records.translation: Um NaN aqui é geralmente significativo: uma característica de patógeno é o NaN para uma célula sem patógeno. A queda da característica mantém todos os objetos; deixar cair as linhas mantém todas as características, mas muda a população que você está olhando.

records.key: Available memory could not be measured, so the worker count is limited to {workers}.
records.source: Available memory could not be measured, so the worker count is limited to {workers}.
records.translation: A memória disponível não pôde ser medida, assim que a contagem do worker é limitada a {workers}.

records.key: Centred puts the middle of the lit run under the pointer; trailing puts its leading end there and drags the rest of the light behind.
records.source: Centred puts the middle of the lit run under the pointer; trailing puts its leading end there and drags the rest of the light behind.
records.translation: Centrado coloca o meio do trecho iluminado sob o ponteiro; arrastando coloca sua extremidade principal lá e arrasta o resto da luz para trás.

records.key: Choose the measurements database, tables and feature columns that enter the map, then exclude unwanted rows or redundant measurements before fitting anything.
records.source: Choose the measurements database, tables and feature columns that enter the map, then exclude unwanted rows or redundant measurements before fitting anything.
records.translation: Escolha o banco de dados de medidas, tabelas e colunas de características que entram no mapa e exclua linhas indesejadas ou medições redundantes antes de encaixar qualquer coisa.

records.key: Control whether features used to calculate the source score are included in the model. Comparing both fits indicates how much performance remains without those potentially circular inputs.
records.source: Control whether features used to calculate the source score are included in the model. Comparing both fits indicates how much performance remains without those potentially circular inputs.
records.translation: Controle se as características usadas para calcular a pontuação de origem estão incluídos no modelo. Comparar ambos os ajustes indica quanto desempenho permanece sem essas entradas potencialmente circulares.

records.key: Could not open those crops
records.source: Could not open those crops
records.translation: Não foi possível abrir esses recortes

records.key: Download every read. The four runs are about 20 GB in total.
records.source: Download every read. The four runs are about 20 GB in total.
records.translation: Faça o download de cada leitura. As quatro execuções são de cerca de 20 GB no total.

records.key: Drop intensity images and label masks made outside spaCR, review the detected cell, nucleus, pathogen and organelle assignments, then build merged arrays, measurements and single-object crops ready for Annotate.
records.source: Drop intensity images and label masks made outside spaCR, review the detected cell, nucleus, pathogen and organelle assignments, then build merged arrays, measurements and single-object crops ready for Annotate.
records.translation: As imagens de intensidade da gota e as máscaras de etiqueta feitas fora de spaCR, revisam as atribuições detectadas da célula, do núcleo, do patógeno e do organelle, a seguir constroem matrizes fundidas, medidas e recortes do único-objeto prontas para anotar.

records.key: Encoding runs separately for every stain and names it in the column. Projection mixes them into three and is faster.
records.source: Encoding runs separately for every stain and names it in the column. Projection mixes them into three and is faster.
records.translation: A codificação é executada separadamente para cada coloração e nomeia-a na coluna. A projeção as mistura em três e é mais rápida.

records.key: Explore measurements using visualization, tabulation, gating and feature-analysis tools.
records.source: Explore measurements using visualization, tabulation, gating and feature-analysis tools.
records.translation: Explore as medições usando ferramentas de visualização, tabulação, gating e análise de características.

records.key: Extract per-object intensity + morphology features from masks and write them to the measurements database.
records.source: Extract per-object intensity + morphology features from masks and write them to the measurements database.
records.translation: Extraia as características de intensidade + morfologia por objeto das máscaras e escreva-os no banco de dados de medições.

records.key: Fold this run's figures away.
records.source: Fold this run's figures away.
records.translation: Dobre os números desta execução.

records.key: Go to the screen this run belongs to.
records.source: Go to the screen this run belongs to.
records.translation: Vá para a triagem a que esta execução pertence.

records.key: Hold this run at its next safe checkpoint.
records.source: Hold this run at its next safe checkpoint.
records.translation: Mantenha esta execução em seu próximo posto de controle seguro.

records.key: How many cores the fit is spread over, and how much it prints on the way. Lower the worker count when the machine has other work to do; raise the verbosity when a fit is failing and you cannot see where.
records.source: How many cores the fit is spread over, and how much it prints on the way. Lower the worker count when the machine has other work to do; raise the verbosity when a fit is failing and you cannot see where.
records.translation: Quantos núcleos o ajuste está espalhado, e quanto ele imprime no caminho. Reduza a contagem do worker quando a máquina tem outro trabalho a fazer; aumente a verbosidade quando um ajuste está falhando e você não pode ver onde.

records.key: How the cut-off separating the two populations is chosen, and how much disagreement between methods is tolerated before the run says so. This is the single most consequential group in the assay.
records.source: How the cut-off separating the two populations is chosen, and how much disagreement between methods is tolerated before the run says so. This is the single most consequential group in the assay.
records.translation: Como o ponto de corte que separa as duas populações é escolhido, e quanto desacordo entre os métodos é tolerado antes da execução diz assim. Este é o único grupo mais consequente no ensaio.

records.key: How the feature table is reduced to two dimensions and clustered on top of that — neighbourhood size, distance metric, and the DBSCAN/KMeans parameters with their noise handling. Change these when the embedding is one undifferentiated blob, or shatters into dozens of tiny clusters.
records.source: How the feature table is reduced to two dimensions and clustered on top of that — neighbourhood size, distance metric, and the DBSCAN/KMeans parameters with their noise handling. Change these when the embedding is one undifferentiated blob, or shatters into dozens of tiny clusters.
records.translation: Como a tabela de características é reduzida a duas dimensões e agrupada em cima disso tamanho da vizinhança, métrica de distância e os parâmetros DBSCAN/KMeans com o manuseio de ruído. Mude-os quando a incorporação for uma bolha indiferenciada ou se fragmentar em dezenas de pequenos clusters.

records.key: Label (optional) — e.g. 'plate 3 mask, 30 px'
records.source: Label (optional) — e.g. 'plate 3 mask, 30 px'
records.translation: Rótulo (opcional) p. ex., «máscara da placa 3, 30 px»

records.key: Load a table or use Merge tables to create a working set with validated keys and aggregation. Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels.
records.source: Load a table or use Merge tables to create a working set with validated keys and aggregation. Define threshold or polygon gates on actual feature/coordinate columns, then apply the saved gate to compatible objects. Use Annotate to write the displayed gates to an annotation column; review the selected objects and choose binary or multiclass labels.
records.translation: Carregue uma tabela ou use Mesclar tabelas para criar um conjunto de trabalho com chaves validadas e agregação. Defina os gates de limite ou polígono em colunas de característica/coordenação reais e, em seguida, aplique o gate salvo a objetos compatíveis. Use Anotar para gravar os gates exibidos em uma coluna de anotação; revise os objetos selecionados e escolha rótulos binários ou multiclasse.

records.key: Look up what any measured feature means — its definition, its unit, which objects it exists for and which module computes it.
records.source: Look up what any measured feature means — its definition, its unit, which objects it exists for and which module computes it.
records.translation: Procure o que qualquer característica medida significa – sua definição, sua unidade, para quais objetos ele existe e qual módulo o computa.

records.key: Masks were not kept for this run, so there is nothing to draw.
records.source: Masks were not kept for this run, so there is nothing to draw.
records.translation: As máscaras não foram mantidas para esta execução, então não há nada para desenhar.

records.key: Masks were not kept for this run.
records.source: Masks were not kept for this run.
records.translation: As máscaras não foram guardadas para esta execução.

records.key: ND2 / CZI / LIF / OME-TIFF / TIFF / PNG into Yokogawa-named TIFFs that Mask and Measure read directly. The mapping is shown before anything is written, and a conversion_map.csv in the destination records which original file every converted name came from.
records.source: ND2 / CZI / LIF / OME-TIFF / TIFF / PNG into Yokogawa-named TIFFs that Mask and Measure read directly. The mapping is shown before anything is written, and a conversion_map.csv in the destination records which original file every converted name came from.
records.translation: ND2 / CZI / LIF / OME-TIFF / TIFF / PNG em TIFFs com o nome de Yokogawa que Mask e Measure leem diretamente. O mapeamento é mostrado antes de qualquer coisa ser escrita, e um conversion_map.csv nos registros de destino de qual arquivo original cada nome convertido veio.

records.key: No microscope lights a field evenly, so the same cell measures brighter at the centre than at a corner — routinely 10–40% on a widefield screen, and it does not average out of a per-well aggregate. This estimates the illumination field from the plate's own merged fields (a per-pixel median across fields, then a smooth low-order surface), QCs it, and installs it as a preprocessing hook that every measure worker applies before a single feature is computed.
records.source: No microscope lights a field evenly, so the same cell measures brighter at the centre than at a corner — routinely 10–40% on a widefield screen, and it does not average out of a per-well aggregate. This estimates the illumination field from the plate's own merged fields (a per-pixel median across fields, then a smooth low-order surface), QCs it, and installs it as a preprocessing hook that every measure worker applies before a single feature is computed.
records.translation: Nenhum microscópio ilumina um campo uniformemente, de modo que a mesma célula mede mais brilhante no centro do que em um canto - rotineiramente 10-40% em uma triagem widefield, e não tem uma média de um agregado por poço. Isso estima o campo de iluminação dos próprios campos mesclados da placa (uma mediana por pixel em todos os campos, em seguida, uma superfície suave de baixa ordem), QCs e instala-o como um gancho de pré-processamento que cada worker de medição é aplicado antes.

records.key: On: objects are brighter than background, as in fluorescence. Off: take the dark side instead, for brightfield or stain.
records.source: On: objects are brighter than background, as in fluorescence. Off: take the dark side instead, for brightfield or stain.
records.translation: Ativado: os objetos são mais brilhantes do que o fundo, como na fluorescência. Desativado: usa o lado escuro, para campo claro ou coloração.

records.key: Open the Annotate screen first — it is what shows crops.
records.source: Open the Annotate screen first — it is what shows crops.
records.translation: Abra primeiro a tela Annotate — é ela que mostra os recortes.

records.key: Penalised least squares with an L2 penalty, which never sets a coefficient to exactly zero -- so there is no selection frequency to report, every feature would score 1.0, and it falls back to an approximate p-value. That test is mis-specified, in the safe direction: the standard error is unpenalised while the coefficient it divides has been shrunk, so the statistic is too small and ridge under-detects rather than manufacturing hits.
records.source: Penalised least squares with an L2 penalty, which never sets a coefficient to exactly zero -- so there is no selection frequency to report, every feature would score 1.0, and it falls back to an approximate p-value. That test is mis-specified, in the safe direction: the standard error is unpenalised while the coefficient it divides has been shrunk, so the statistic is too small and ridge under-detects rather than manufacturing hits.
records.translation: Os mínimos quadrados penalizados com uma penalidade L2, que nunca define um coeficiente para exatamente zero - então não há frequência de seleção para relatar, cada característica marcaria 1,0 e cairia de volta para um valor aproximado de p. Esse teste é mal especificado, na direção segura: o erro padrão é não penalizado enquanto o coeficiente que divide foi reduzido, então a estatística é muito pequena e o cume é subdetetado em vez de atingir a fabricação.

records.key: Per channel (one pass per stain)
records.source: Per channel (one pass per stain)
records.translation: Por canal (uma passagem por coloração)

records.key:
Planes displayed in the montage. Enter the colour letters used by Annotate — r, g, b, or a combination such as 'r,g,b', 'rg', or 'b' — and each letter is resolved to the corresponding source channel. Source-channel indices such as '0,1,2' are also accepted.

Left empty, the run's own png_dims are read back out of measurements.db, so the crops match the PNGs that run wrote.
records.source:
Planes displayed in the montage. Enter the colour letters used by Annotate — r, g, b, or a combination such as 'r,g,b', 'rg', or 'b' — and each letter is resolved to the corresponding source channel. Source-channel indices such as '0,1,2' are also accepted.

Left empty, the run's own png_dims are read back out of measurements.db, so the crops match the PNGs that run wrote.
records.translation: planos exibidos na montagem. Digite as letras coloridas usadas por Anotate r, g, b, ou uma combinação como 'r,g,b', 'rg', ou 'b' e cada letra é resolvida para o canal de origem correspondente. ndices de canais-fonte como '0,1,2' também são aceitos. Deixado vazio, o próprio png_dims da execução é lido de volta de measurements.db, então os recortes correspondem ao PNGs que foi escrito.

records.key: Reduce each well to the median of each feature and run the same rule across wells. A whole bad well flags almost none of its individual objects, so this is a different test rather than a summary of the one above.
records.source: Reduce each well to the median of each feature and run the same rule across wells. A whole bad well flags almost none of its individual objects, so this is a different test rather than a summary of the one above.
records.translation: Reduza cada poço para a mediana de cada característica e execute a mesma regra em poços. Um poço totalmente ruim sinaliza quase nenhum de seus objetos individuais, então este é um teste diferente em vez de um resumo do acima.

records.key: Requested worker count. The sweep clamps it according to available memory; see Containment below for whether kernel-enforced per-trial limits are active.
records.source: Requested worker count. The sweep clamps it according to available memory; see Containment below for whether kernel-enforced per-trial limits are active.
records.translation: Contagem de worker solicitada. A varredura prende-o de acordo com a memória disponível; consulte Contention abaixo para saber se os limites por teste aplicados pelo kernel estão ativos.

records.key: Score how well two or more annotation passes agree with Cohen's or Fleiss' κ, then review every crop they labelled differently.
records.source: Score how well two or more annotation passes agree with Cohen's or Fleiss' κ, then review every crop they labelled differently.
records.translation: Marque o quão bem dois ou mais passes de anotação concordam com o κ de Cohen ou Fleiss e, em seguida, revise cada recorte que eles rotularam de forma diferente.

records.key: Search definitions of measured features by name or concept
records.source: Search definitions of measured features by name or concept
records.translation: Definições de pesquisa de características medidas por nome ou conceito

records.key: Search failed: the worker returned no result.
records.source: Search failed: the worker returned no result.
records.translation: A pesquisa falhou: o worker não retornou nenhum resultado.

records.key: Select a run to inspect it.
records.source: Select a run to inspect it.
records.translation: Selecione uma execução para inspecioná-la.

records.key: Select the column that defines object classes, then score and rank continuous features by class separation. The default AUC metric is rank-based and independent of measurement units. The results describe limitations of the selected statistic, flag features whose classes differ primarily in spread, and use a permutation test to estimate the best separation expected by chance across the feature set.
records.source: Select the column that defines object classes, then score and rank continuous features by class separation. The default AUC metric is rank-based and independent of measurement units. The results describe limitations of the selected statistic, flag features whose classes differ primarily in spread, and use a permutation test to estimate the best separation expected by chance across the feature set.
records.translation: Selecione a coluna que define as classes de objetos e, em seguida, marque e classifique as características contínuas por separação de classes. A métrica AUC padrão é baseada em classificação e independente das unidades de medição. Os resultados descrevem as limitações da estatística selecionada, sinalizam as características cujas classes diferem principalmente no spread e usam um teste de permutação para estimar a melhor separação esperada por acaso em todo o conjunto de características.

records.key: Set the number of feature-space clusters across which the annotation budget is distributed. Zero uses one cluster per queued cell.
records.source: Set the number of feature-space clusters across which the annotation budget is distributed. Zero uses one cluster per queued cell.
records.translation: Defina o número de clusters de espaço de características em que o orçamento de anotação é distribuído. Zero usa um cluster por célula em fila.

records.key: Set worker parallelism and diagnostic verbosity. Reduce workers when memory is constrained, or increase logging while tracing a failed run.
records.source: Set worker parallelism and diagnostic verbosity. Reduce workers when memory is constrained, or increase logging while tracing a failed run.
records.translation: Defina o paralelismo do worker e a verbosidade diagnóstica. Reduza os processos worker quando a memória é restrita ou aumente o registro enquanto rastreia uma execução com falha.

records.key: Show this run's figures again.
records.source: Show this run's figures again.
records.translation: Mostra os números desta execução outra vez.

records.key: Show this run's own volcano next to the loaded run's, each answering its own hover and click. Two runs can be live at once.
records.source: Show this run's own volcano next to the loaded run's, each answering its own hover and click. Two runs can be live at once.
records.translation: Mostre o próprio vulcão desta execução ao lado da execução carregada, cada uma respondendo ao seu próprio hover e clique. Duas execuções podem ser ao vivo de uma só vez.

records.key: Show this run's results, figures and summary.
records.source: Show this run's results, figures and summary.
records.translation: Mostrar os resultados, números e resumo desta execução.

records.key: Stop this run. You are asked whether to let it finish the step it is on, or to stop it immediately.
records.source: Stop this run. You are asked whether to let it finish the step it is on, or to stop it immediately.
records.translation: Pare esta execução. Você é perguntado se deve deixá-lo terminar o passo em que está, ou para pará-lo imediatamente.

records.key: The diagnostic figures a run draws as it goes — how many example fields, at what size, with which colour map and normalisation. Useful while tuning, and the first thing to switch off for a long unattended run.
records.source: The diagnostic figures a run draws as it goes — how many example fields, at what size, with which colour map and normalisation. Useful while tuning, and the first thing to switch off for a long unattended run.
records.translation: As figuras de diagnóstico de uma execução desenham como vai - quantos campos de exemplo, em que tamanho, com que mapa de cores e normalização. til durante a afinação, e a primeira coisa a desligar para uma longa execução autônoma.

records.key: The feature-based classifier: which model, and which measured features it is allowed to see. Feature preparation and feature importance are one heading because they answer one question.
records.source: The feature-based classifier: which model, and which measured features it is allowed to see. Feature preparation and feature importance are one heading because they answer one question.
records.translation: O classificador baseado em características: qual modelo e quais características medidas ele pode ver. A preparação de características e a importância da característica são um título porque respondem a uma pergunta.

records.key: The older area-bin approximation of replication state, kept so historical analyses still reproduce. New runs should use the direct parasite-per-vacuole counts instead.
records.source: The older area-bin approximation of replication state, kept so historical analyses still reproduce. New runs should use the direct parasite-per-vacuole counts instead.
records.translation: A aproximação área-bin mais antiga do estado de replicação, mantida para que as análises históricas ainda se reproduzam. Novas execuções devem usar as contagens diretas de parasita-por-vacúolo.

records.key: The plan summary and, after a run, what was converted and what was skipped.
records.source: The plan summary and, after a run, what was converted and what was skipped.
records.translation: O resumo do plano e, depois de uma execução, o que foi convertido e o que foi ignorado.

records.key: The tabular model and the feature table it learns from — which estimator, how much of the data is held back, and the pruning that decides which measured features survive. Open it when the model overfits, or when thousands of correlated features are drowning the few that matter.
records.source: The tabular model and the feature table it learns from — which estimator, how much of the data is held back, and the pruning that decides which measured features survive. Open it when the model overfits, or when thousands of correlated features are drowning the few that matter.
records.translation: O modelo tabular e a tabela de características que ele aprende - qual estimador, quanto dos dados é retido e a poda que decide quais características medidas sobrevivem. Abra-o quando o modelo se sobrepõe ou quando milhares de características correlacionadas estão afogando os poucos que importam.

records.key: The two-colour invasion readout: which channels carry the outside and total stains, how the outside signal is measured, how its threshold is chosen and sanity-checked, and which objects count as parasites at all. The table the parasites are read from is under Measurements.
records.source: The two-colour invasion readout: which channels carry the outside and total stains, how the outside signal is measured, how its threshold is chosen and sanity-checked, and which objects count as parasites at all. The table the parasites are read from is under Measurements.
records.translation: A leitura de invasão de duas cores: quais canais carregam as colorações externa e total, como o sinal externo é medido, como seu limiar é escolhido e verificado quanto à plausibilidade, e quais objetos contam como parasitas. A tabela da qual os parasitas são lidos está sob Medições.

records.key: This run's volcano as it last looked. A still, not a live plot: open the run to hover, click and filter it.
records.source: This run's volcano as it last looked. A still, not a live plot: open the run to hover, click and filter it.
records.translation: Esta execução é vulcão como parecia pela última vez. Um ainda, não um enredo ao vivo: abra a execução para pairar, clique e filtrá-lo.

records.key: Tick at least one run to overlay.
records.source: Tick at least one run to overlay.
records.translation: Marque pelo menos uma execução para a sobreposição.

records.key: Train a classical ML classifier (XGBoost, random forest, …) on per-object features and score every well.
records.source: Train a classical ML classifier (XGBoost, random forest, …) on per-object features and score every well.
records.translation: Treine um classificador ML clássico (XGBoost, floresta aleatória, ...) em características por objeto e marque todos os pontos.

records.key: Train a model on the current annotations, on the images or on the measured features, and apply it to the whole dataset.
records.source: Train a model on the current annotations, on the images or on the measured features, and apply it to the whole dataset.
records.translation: Treine um modelo nas anotações atuais, nas imagens ou nas características medidas e aplique-o a todo o conjunto de dados.

records.key: Train an XGBoost model on the measurement features using the current annotations as class labels, then apply it to score the full dataset. Opens the ML Analyze screen with this source pre-selected.
records.source: Train an XGBoost model on the measurement features using the current annotations as class labels, then apply it to score the full dataset. Opens the ML Analyze screen with this source pre-selected.
records.translation: Treine um modelo XGBoost nas características de medição usando as anotações atuais como rótulos de classe e aplique-o para marcar o conjunto de dados completo. Abre a triagem de análise de ML com essa fonte pré-selecionada.

records.key: Train classifiers from image crops or measured features in one interface. Define classes from plate metadata or annotations, then choose a PyTorch image model or a gradient-boosted feature model.
records.source: Train classifiers from image crops or measured features in one interface. Define classes from plate metadata or annotations, then choose a PyTorch image model or a gradient-boosted feature model.
records.translation: Traine classificadores de recortes de imagem ou características medidas em uma interface. Defina classes a partir de metadados de placa ou anotações e escolha um modelo de imagem PyTorch ou um modelo com característica aumentada por gradiente.

records.key: What defines a class. Pick the training basis first — metadata (the wells named as positive and negative control), annotation (a column the Annotate module wrote), or measurement (thresholds on measured features). The controls the other two bases use are greyed out, not hidden: they keep their values. Get this wrong and every number downstream is meaningless, so check it first.
records.source: What defines a class. Pick the training basis first — metadata (the wells named as positive and negative control), annotation (a column the Annotate module wrote), or measurement (thresholds on measured features). The controls the other two bases use are greyed out, not hidden: they keep their values. Get this wrong and every number downstream is meaningless, so check it first.
records.translation: O que define uma classe. Escolha a base de treinamento primeiro metadados (os poços nomeados como controle positivo e negativo), anotação (uma coluna que o módulo Anotar escreveu) ou medição (limiares em características medidas). Os controles que as outras duas bases usam são cinza, não ocultos: eles mantêm seus valores. Faça isso errado e cada número a jusante não tem sentido, então verifique primeiro.

records.key: Where the training images come from and how they are cut — the crop source, the path and format filters for crops already on disk, and the channels and object to cut around for crops made on demand.
records.source: Where the training images come from and how they are cut — the crop source, the path and format filters for crops already on disk, and the channels and object to cut around for crops made on demand.
records.translation: De onde vêm as imagens de treinamento e como elas são cortadas – a fonte da recorte, o caminho e os filtros de formato para os recortes já em disco, e os canais e objetos a serem cortados para os recortes feitos sob demanda.

records.key: Which family of coefficients is drawn. A run fitted at both levels holds two of them.
records.source: Which family of coefficients is drawn. A run fitted at both levels holds two of them.
records.translation: Qual família de coeficientes é desenhada. Uma execução montada em ambos os níveis contém dois deles.

records.key: Which feature families are computed for the imported masks — intensity, texture, radial distribution and colocalisation. The expensive ones are off by default.
records.source: Which feature families are computed for the imported masks — intensity, texture, radial distribution and colocalisation. The expensive ones are off by default.
records.translation: Quais famílias de características são calculadas para as máscaras importadas - intensidade, textura, distribuição radial e localização. As caras estão desativadas por padrão.

records.key: Which measurement columns are allowed into the model, and the variance, correlation, object-count and compartment filters applied before fitting. Prune here when the feature table is wide, redundant, or contains a column that leaks the answer.
records.source: Which measurement columns are allowed into the model, and the variance, correlation, object-count and compartment filters applied before fitting. Prune here when the feature table is wide, redundant, or contains a column that leaks the answer.
